value.rationale: Two canonical single-one length-three run motifs have identical expected counts but switch covariance sign at the exact abundance threshold b=a+2. Finite fixed-count randomization tests need joint motif statistics rather than marginal frequencies; the strict no-equality phase line is a structural dependence law, not a trivial renaming or a small numerical table.
